senses.en: to prevent something or make it impossible

ex.en: The heavy rain precluded our planned picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 大雨让我们原定的湖边野餐无法进行。

ex.en: High tuition fees may preclude students from disadvantaged backgrounds from accessing higher education without financial support.
ex.zh: 高昂的学费可能使弱势家庭的学生在没有经济资助的情况下无法接受高等教育。

col: preclude someone from doing something｜使某人无法做某事
preclude further discussion｜使进一步讨论无法进行
tip: 正式用词；可用preclude sb from doing sth。

senses.en: Walking on two legs.

ex.en: Bipedalism freed early humans' hands.
ex.zh: 两足行走解放了早期人类的双手。

senses.en: Able to be placed against the other fingers.

ex.en: Primates have opposable thumbs.
ex.zh: 灵长类动物有可对握的拇指。

senses.en: The part of the skull that holds the brain.

ex.en: The cranium was larger than expected.
ex.zh: 这块颅骨比预想的大。

senses.en: The lower jawbone.

ex.en: A mandible with teeth was found.
ex.zh: 发现了一块带牙的下颌骨。

senses.en: The thigh bone.

ex.en: The femur showed the person walked upright.
ex.zh: 股骨显示此人直立行走。

senses.en: The study of bones.

ex.en: Osteology reveals age and diet.
ex.zh: 骨学能揭示年龄和饮食。

senses.en: Produced or expressed in very large amounts

ex.en: He offered profuse apologies for spilling my tea.
ex.zh: 他打翻了我的茶，连声道歉。

ex.en: Profuse sweating during outdoor exercise can increase fluid loss, making regular water intake particularly important.
ex.zh: 户外运动时大量出汗会增加水分流失，因此定期补水尤为重要。

tip: 常修饰出汗、道歉或感谢，强调量大或反复。

senses.en: The study of human remains from archaeological sites.

ex.en: Bioarchaeology shows how ancient people lived.
ex.zh: 生物考古学揭示古人如何生活。

senses.en: The study of human evolution through fossils.

ex.en: Paleoanthropology traces our ancestors.
ex.zh: 古人类学追溯我们的祖先。

senses.en: The detailed study of a particular culture.

ex.en: Her ethnography describes village life.
ex.zh: 她的民族志描述了乡村生活。

senses.en: A person who studies and describes cultures.

ex.en: The ethnographer recorded local songs.
ex.zh: 这位民族志学者记录了当地歌曲。

senses.en: Relating to the study of cultures.

ex.en: Ethnographic fieldwork takes many months.
ex.zh: 民族志田野调查需要好几个月。

senses.en: The comparative study of cultures.

ex.en: Ethnology compares customs across societies.
ex.zh: 民族学比较不同社会的习俗。

senses.en: To make someone annoyed, worried, or frustrated.

ex.en: The constant dripping from the tap began to vex him.
ex.zh: 水龙头不停滴水，开始让他心烦。

ex.en: Disagreements over how to fund public transport continue to vex policymakers in many growing cities.
ex.zh: 在许多不断发展的城市，公共交通资金来源的分歧仍困扰着政策制定者。

col: be vexed by delays｜因延误而烦恼
tip: 较正式的及物动词，日常多用annoy。

senses.en: Family relationship.

ex.en: Kinship ties organize village life.
ex.zh: 亲属关系组织着乡村生活。

senses.en: A society ruled by a chief.

ex.en: Chiefdoms were larger than tribes.
ex.zh: 酋邦比部落规模更大。

senses.en: A way of life based on raising livestock.

ex.en: Pastoralism suits dry grasslands.
ex.zh: 畜牧生活适合干旱草原。

senses.en: A person who looks after a herd of animals.

ex.en: Herders move their goats to new pastures.
ex.zh: 牧人把山羊赶到新的牧场。

senses.en: A person who lives by hunting animals and gathering wild plants.

ex.en: Humans were hunter-gatherers for most of history.
ex.zh: 在历史的大部分时间里，人类是狩猎采集者。

senses.en: A person or animal that searches for food.

ex.en: Foragers knew hundreds of edible plants.
ex.zh: 采集者认识数百种可食用植物。

senses.en: Staying in one place; involving much sitting.

ex.en: Farming led to sedentary villages.
ex.zh: 农业催生了定居的村落。

senses.en: A small detail or distinction requiring careful understanding
A small convention of polite social behaviour

ex.en: I am still learning the niceties of formal dining.
ex.zh: 我还在学习正式用餐的礼仪细节。

ex.en: Understanding the niceties of legal language is essential when translating international agreements that affect trade and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 翻译涉及贸易和环境保护的国际协议时，理解法律语言的细微差别至关重要。

col: legal niceties｜法律上的细微区别
tip: 多用复数 niceties，勿直接理解为“美好”。

senses.en: The practice of living in one place for a long time.

ex.en: Sedentism began before farming in some regions.
ex.zh: 在一些地区，定居早于农业出现。

senses.en: Taming animals or growing plants for human use.

ex.en: The domestication of wheat began 10,000 years ago.
ex.zh: 小麦的驯化始于一万年前。

senses.en: Relating to the Old Stone Age.

ex.en: Paleolithic people painted cave walls.
ex.zh: 旧石器时代的人在洞壁上作画。

senses.en: Relating to the Middle Stone Age.

ex.en: Mesolithic hunters used tiny stone blades.
ex.zh: 中石器时代的猎人使用细小石刃。

senses.en: Tracing family descent through the mother.

ex.en: In matrilineal societies, land passes to daughters.
ex.zh: 在母系社会中，土地传给女儿。

senses.en: Tracing family descent through the father.

ex.en: Surnames are usually patrilineal.
ex.zh: 姓氏通常是父系传承的。

senses.en: to distort something good or proper for harmful purposes

ex.en: The coach perverted fair competition by secretly changing the rules.
ex.zh: 教练暗中修改规则，破坏了公平竞争。

ex.en: Political pressure can pervert scientific research when funding depends on producing results that support existing policies.
ex.zh: 当资助取决于研究结果是否支持现行政策时，政治压力可能使科研偏离正轨。

col: pervert the course of justice｜妨碍司法公正
tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前且常含贬义。

senses.en: Ruled or led by women.

ex.en: The elephant herd is matriarchal.
ex.zh: 象群是母系领导的。

senses.en: Ruled or controlled by men.

ex.en: The novel criticizes patriarchal society.
ex.zh: 这部小说批判了父权社会。

senses.en: A society in which women hold power.

ex.en: True matriarchies are rare.
ex.zh: 真正的母权社会很少见。

senses.en: A society in which men hold power.

ex.en: Feminists challenged patriarchy.
ex.zh: 女权主义者挑战父权制。

senses.en: Having more than one spouse at the same time.

ex.en: Polygamy is illegal in many countries.
ex.zh: 多偶制在许多国家是违法的。

senses.en: Having only one partner at a time.

ex.en: Monogamy is rare among mammals.
ex.zh: 一夫一妻制在哺乳动物中很少见。

senses.en: The theft of small amounts or items, especially from workplaces.

ex.en: The shop now locks its stockroom to prevent pilferage.
ex.zh: 这家商店现在把库房锁起来，以防东西被顺手偷走。

ex.en: Retailers can reduce losses from pilferage by improving stock monitoring and providing secure storage for valuable goods.
ex.zh: 零售商可以通过加强库存监控并为贵重商品提供安全储存空间，减少小额失窃造成的损失。

col: losses from pilferage｜小额失窃造成的损失
tip: pilferage是不可数名词，不是动词；动词为pilfer。

senses.en: A man having more than one wife.

ex.en: Polygyny was practiced by some kings.
ex.zh: 一些国王实行一夫多妻。

senses.en: A woman having more than one husband.

ex.en: Polyandry occurs in parts of the Himalayas.
ex.zh: 喜马拉雅部分地区存在一妻多夫制。

senses.en: Money or goods a bride's family gives at marriage.

ex.en: Her dowry included land and cattle.
ex.zh: 她的嫁妆包括土地和牛。

senses.en: Marrying outside one's own group.

ex.en: Exogamy builds alliances between clans.
ex.zh: 族外婚在氏族之间建立联盟。

senses.en: Marrying within one's own group.

ex.en: Caste rules required endogamy.
ex.zh: 种姓规则要求族内通婚。

senses.en: The belief that natural objects have spirits.

ex.en: Animism sees spirits in rivers and trees.
ex.zh: 万物有灵论认为河流和树木都有灵魂。

senses.en: showing strength and energy traditionally associated with men

ex.en: The sculpture portrays a virile athlete lifting a discus.
ex.zh: 这座雕塑刻画了一位举起铁饼、充满阳刚之气的运动员。

ex.en: Advertisements often present a virile male ideal, which may reinforce narrow expectations about men's appearance and behaviour.
ex.zh: 广告常常展示阳刚的理想男性形象，这可能强化对男性外貌和行为的狭隘期待。

col: virile young man｜强健的年轻男子
tip: 不只是“男性的”；强调传统观念中的男性力量与活力。

senses.en: A person who believes natural objects have spirits.

ex.en: Animist beliefs shaped local festivals.
ex.zh: 万物有灵的信仰塑造了当地节日。

senses.en: A person believed to communicate with spirits and heal the sick.

ex.en: The shaman led the healing ceremony.
ex.zh: 萨满主持了治疗仪式。

senses.en: Religious practice centered on shamans.

ex.en: Shamanism is found across Siberia.
ex.zh: 萨满教遍布西伯利亚。

senses.en: A formal religious or traditional ceremony.

ex.en: The rite marked a boy's passage to manhood.
ex.zh: 这个仪式标志着男孩成年。

senses.en: A ceremony for joining a group; the start of something.

ex.en: Initiation rites were held at puberty.
ex.zh: 成年礼在青春期举行。

senses.en: Belief in a spiritual link between a group and an animal or plant.

ex.en: Totemism links clans to animals.
ex.zh: 图腾崇拜把氏族与动物联系起来。

senses.en: a long, detailed piece of writing about a particular subject

ex.en: I found a dusty treatise on gardening upstairs.
ex.zh: 我在楼上找到了一本落满灰尘的园艺专著。

ex.en: The philosopher's treatise on education argues that practical experience should play a central role in learning.
ex.zh: 这位哲学家的教育论著主张，实践经验应在学习中发挥核心作用。

tip: 常用a treatise on，指系统详尽的专论而非短文。

senses.en: Relating to myths; very famous or exaggerated.

ex.en: The founder became a mythic figure.
ex.zh: 这位创始人成了传奇人物。

senses.en: Traditional stories and beliefs of a community.

ex.en: Dragons appear in Chinese folklore.
ex.zh: 龙出现在中国民间传说中。

senses.en: A West African storyteller who keeps oral history.

ex.en: The griot sang the history of the kings.
ex.zh: 格里奥吟唱了历代国王的历史。

senses.en: A poet who sings stories; a poet.

ex.en: The bard sang of ancient battles.
ex.zh: 吟游诗人歌唱古代的战争。

senses.en: A Pacific Northwest feast where hosts give away goods to show status.

ex.en: Chiefs gained prestige by hosting a potlatch.
ex.zh: 首领通过举办夸富宴赢得威望。

senses.en: Exchanging things for mutual benefit.

ex.en: Gift-giving is based on reciprocity.
ex.zh: 送礼基于互惠原则。

senses.en: found naturally only in one particular place
regularly found among people in a particular area

ex.en: This flower is endemic to the island.
ex.zh: 这种花是这座岛特有的。

ex.en: Because many species on the islands are endemic, the arrival of rats and goats caused extinctions that could not be reversed elsewhere.
ex.zh: 由于岛上许多物种为当地特有，老鼠和山羊的到来导致了无法在别处挽回的灭绝。

tip: endemic to + 地点；别和 epidemic（流行病）混淆。

senses.en: Collecting and sharing out goods again.

ex.en: The chief controlled the redistribution of food.
ex.zh: 首领掌管食物的再分配。

senses.en: Believing that all people are equal.

ex.en: Hunter-gatherer bands were largely egalitarian.
ex.zh: 狩猎采集群体大多是平等的。

senses.en: Division into layers or classes.

ex.en: Social stratification grew with farming.
ex.zh: 社会分层随着农业而加剧。

senses.en: The leader of a tribe or clan.

ex.en: The chieftain led his warriors into battle.
ex.zh: 首领率领战士们出征。

senses.en: The leader of a village or community.

ex.en: The headman welcomed the visitors.
ex.zh: 村长欢迎了来访者。

senses.en: A very small village.

ex.en: The hamlet has only twelve houses.
ex.zh: 这个小村庄只有十二户人家。

senses.en: Form an opinion using limited evidence
An opinion formed without enough evidence to be certain

ex.en: Seeing wet umbrellas, I surmised that it was raining.
ex.zh: 看到湿漉漉的雨伞，我猜外面正在下雨。

ex.en: Researchers surmise that flexible schedules improve employee wellbeing, although stronger evidence is needed to confirm this.
ex.zh: 研究人员推测弹性工作时间能改善员工身心状况，但仍需更有力的证据加以确认。

tip: 较正式，强调证据不足；动词常接that从句。

senses.en: A place with temporary shelters or tents.

ex.en: Traces of a hunting encampment were found.
ex.zh: 发现了一处狩猎营地的遗迹。

senses.en: A long communal house shared by several families.

ex.en: Iroquois families lived in longhouses.
ex.zh: 易洛魁家庭住在长屋里。

senses.en: A dome-shaped hut of poles covered with bark or hides.

ex.en: The wigwam was covered with birch bark.
ex.zh: 棚屋上覆盖着桦树皮。

senses.en: A cone-shaped tent of animal skins used by Plains peoples.

ex.en: The tepee could be packed up quickly.
ex.zh: 圆锥形帐篷可以很快收起。

senses.en: A dome-shaped house built of snow blocks.

ex.en: Hunters built an igloo for the night.
ex.zh: 猎人们搭了一座冰屋过夜。

senses.en: A round felt tent used by nomads in Central Asia.

ex.en: The family lives in a yurt in summer.
ex.zh: 这家人夏天住在蒙古包里。

senses.en: Sun-dried brick made of clay and straw.

ex.en: Adobe houses stay cool in the desert.
ex.zh: 土坯房在沙漠中保持凉爽。

senses.en: Able to be ended, especially under agreed conditions

ex.en: My rental agreement is terminable with one month's notice.
ex.zh: 我的租约可以提前一个月通知后终止。

ex.en: Employment contracts should be terminable by either party, provided that reasonable notice is given.
ex.zh: 只要给予合理的提前通知，雇佣合同应允许任何一方终止。

col: terminable on notice｜通知后可终止的
terminable by either party｜任何一方均可终止的
tip: 正式法律用语，常形容合同；不等于terminal。

senses.en: Dried straw or reeds used as roofing.

ex.en: The cottage has a roof of thatch.
ex.zh: 这座小屋有茅草屋顶。

senses.en: Covered with a roof of straw or reeds.

ex.en: They lived in a thatched hut.
ex.zh: 他们住在一间茅草屋里。

senses.en: The floor of a fireplace; home.

ex.en: Ash from the hearth was carbon dated.
ex.zh: 炉膛里的灰烬做了碳测年。

senses.en: Cutting hillsides into flat steps for farming.

ex.en: Terracing prevents soil erosion on slopes.
ex.zh: 修梯田可以防止坡地水土流失。

senses.en: A raised road across water or wet ground.

ex.en: A causeway linked the island to the shore.
ex.zh: 一条堤道把小岛和海岸连接起来。

senses.en: A bank or mound of earth built as a defense or monument.

ex.en: The hill is ringed by ancient earthworks.
ex.zh: 山周围环绕着古代土垒。

senses.en: say what will happen, especially through claimed spiritual knowledge

ex.en: The old storyteller prophesied that the kingdom would prosper.
ex.zh: 那位年老的说书人预言这个王国会繁荣兴盛。

ex.en: Some early commentators prophesied that television would replace books, but reading has remained an important cultural activity.
ex.zh: 一些早期评论者曾预言电视会取代书籍，但阅读始终是一项重要的文化活动。

senses.en: A defensive wall of earth or stone.

ex.en: Soldiers stood guard on the rampart.
ex.zh: 士兵们站在城墙上守卫。

senses.en: A fence of wooden stakes for defense.

ex.en: A palisade surrounded the village.
ex.zh: 木栅栏环绕着村庄。

senses.en: A defensive barrier of upright posts.

ex.en: Settlers built a stockade for protection.
ex.zh: 移民建了一道栅栏来自保。

senses.en: A wall or building constructed for defense.

ex.en: Stone fortifications protected the city.
ex.zh: 石砌防御工事保护着城市。

senses.en: A fortress protecting a city.

ex.en: The citadel stands on the highest hill.
ex.zh: 城堡矗立在最高的山上。

senses.en: The fortified high area of an ancient Greek city.

ex.en: The Parthenon stands on the Acropolis.
ex.zh: 帕特农神庙矗立在雅典卫城上。

senses.en: An indirect suggestion or indication of something.

ex.en: His sudden silence gave us an intimation of trouble.
ex.zh: 他突然沉默，让我们隐约感到出了问题。

ex.en: The minister's remarks offered the first intimation that funding for public transport might increase.
ex.zh: 部长的讲话首次暗示，公共交通资金可能会增加。

col: an intimation of trouble｜麻烦的征兆
tip: 别与intimacy（亲密）混淆；常接of或that从句。

senses.en: A stepped pyramid temple of ancient Mesopotamia.

ex.en: The ziggurat rose above the city of Ur.
ex.zh: 塔庙高耸于乌尔城之上。

senses.en: A holy place dedicated to a god or saint.

ex.en: Pilgrims visited the shrine.
ex.zh: 朝圣者参拜了圣地。

senses.en: A table used in religious ceremonies.

ex.en: Offerings were placed on the altar.
ex.zh: 供品被放在祭坛上。

senses.en: A drink poured out as an offering to a god.

ex.en: Wine was poured as a libation.
ex.zh: 酒被洒在地上作为奠酒。

senses.en: A priest or place believed to give messages from the gods.

ex.en: The oracle at Delphi gave cryptic answers.
ex.zh: 德尔斐神谕给出了晦涩的回答。

senses.en: Trying to foretell the future by supernatural means.

ex.en: Oracle bones were used for divination.
ex.zh: 甲骨被用于占卜。

senses.en: Thick and sticky, especially when cooked

ex.en: The glutinous rice stuck firmly to my wooden spoon.
ex.zh: 糯米牢牢地粘在了我的木勺上。

ex.en: Glutinous rice is used in many traditional dishes, reflecting the importance of texture in regional cuisines.
ex.zh: 许多传统菜肴使用糯米，体现了口感在地方饮食中的重要性。

tip: glutinous指黏性；糯米本身不含麸质gluten。

senses.en: A sign of what will happen; reading omens.

ex.en: Romans practiced augury by watching birds.
ex.zh: 罗马人通过观察鸟类进行占卜。

senses.en: A person who claims to predict the future.

ex.en: A soothsayer warned Caesar of danger.
ex.zh: 一位预言者警告恺撒有危险。

senses.en: A woman who performs religious duties.

ex.en: The priestess tended the sacred fire.
ex.zh: 女祭司照看圣火。

senses.en: A system of worship; a small extreme religious group.

ex.en: The cult of Isis spread across the Roman Empire.
ex.zh: 伊西斯崇拜传遍了罗马帝国。

senses.en: All the gods of a religion; a group of famous people.

ex.en: Zeus ruled the Greek pantheon.
ex.zh: 宙斯统领希腊众神。

senses.en: Belief in many gods.

ex.en: Ancient Egyptian religion was a form of polytheism.
ex.zh: 古埃及宗教是一种多神信仰。
